response: Divide the shaded polygon into parts. Rectangle from x=3 to x=5, y=1 to y=4: width 2 by height 3 gives 6 square cm. Add the triangle formed by (5,1), (6,2), (5,3), which has base 2 (vertical from y=1 to y=3 at x=5) and height 1 (horizontal from x=5 to x=6), so area = 1/2 x 2 x 1 = 1 square cm.
